sn28.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sārīputto rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn28.10:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
sn28.10:1.3: rājagahe sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ aññataraṃ kuḍḍamūlaṃ nissāya bhuñjati.
sn28.10:1.4: atha kho sūcimukhī paribbājikā yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
sn28.10:2.1: kiṃ nu kho samaṇa adhomukho bhuñjasīti.
sn28.10:3.1: kiṃ nu samaṇa adhomukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno na khvāhaṃ bhagini adhomukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi
sn28.10:3.2: tenahi samaṇa ubbhamukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno na khvāhaṃ bhagini ubbhamukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi
sn28.10:3.3: tenahi samaṇa disāmukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno na khvāhaṃ bhagini disāmukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi
sn28.10:3.4: tenahi samaṇa vidisāmukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno na khvāhaṃ bhagini vidisāmukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi
sn28.10:4.2: ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā vatthuvijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā adhomukhā bhuñjanti.
sn28.10:4.3: ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā nakkhattavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā ubbhamukhā bhuñjanti.
sn28.10:4.4: ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā dūteyyapahiṇagamanānuyogā micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā disāmukhā bhuñjanti.
sn28.10:4.5: ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā aṅgavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā vidisāmukhā bhuñjanti.
sn28.10:5.1: so khvāhaṃ bhagini na vatthuvijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi na nakkhattavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi na dūteyyapahiṇagamanānuyogā micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi na aṅgavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi
sn28.10:6.1: atha kho sūcimukhī paribbājikā rājagahe rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamārocesi
